newsitem.title: USA: VALHI UNIT TO TENDER FOR ITS NOTES.
newsitem.headline: VALHI UNIT TO TENDER FOR ITS NOTES.

text.p: Valcor Inc, a subsidiary of Valhi Inc, said on Wednesday it has commenced a consent solicitation and tender offer for its Valcor's 9-5/8 percent senior notes due 2003, of which $68.6 million principal amount is currently outstanding.
Valcor is soliciting consents to amend certain provisions of the indenture that governs the notes, the company said in a statement.

The consent solicitation expires at 1800 EDT on the later of August 27, 1997 or the date of receipt of the requisite consents necessary to approve the proposed amendments, unless extended, Valcor said.
Valcor will pay a consent fee equal to $10 per $1,000 principal amount of the notes for which the holder delivers a consent prior to the expiration of the solicitation, it said.

In the tender offer, Valcor is offering to purchase any and all of its outstanding notes for a cash purchase price equal to $1,040 per $1,000 principal amount of the tendered notes plus accrued and unpaid interest to.
The tender offer expires at 1800 EDT on September 4, 1997, unless extended.
